title: Hearty German Veal Grill
description: A winey, tender veal grill with a creamy sour cream sauce, low-sodium friendly, served in a yakimono-style pan.
instructions: In a shallow dish, whisk together sour cream, Dijon mustard, wine, vinegar, paprika, thyme, salt, pepper, and lemon zest until smooth.
Pat veal cutlets dry and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Coat each cutlet with the sauce mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat a yakimono-style grill pan over medium-high heat and add butter, letting it melt and brown.
Place the coated veal cutlets onto the grill and sear for 3 minutes per side until a golden crust forms.
Reduce heat to medium, cover, and grill for an additional 4-5 minutes until internal temperature reaches 140°F (60°C).
Remove from grill, let rest for 5 minutes to redistribute juices.
Slice each cutlet, drizzle remaining sauce over, and serve immediately with a side of steamed greens.
